# ailiu.online

> ailiu.online is the personal portfolio of a designer and AI builder. The site presents product, brand, and AI tool work with concise case studies, visuals, roles, platforms, and project status.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://ailiu.online/): Personal portfolio homepage for ailiu, a designer and AI builder focused on turning early ideas into polished, working products.
- [Aviso](https://ailiu.online/projects/aviso): Case study for a Chrome extension that brings in-page AI commands, selected-text actions, local history, and BYOK model access into the browsing workflow.
- [小姨家](https://ailiu.online/projects/xiaoyi): Case study for a food and beverage brand system built around the feeling of home, including naming, identity, packaging, menu, and spatial touchpoints.

## About

ailiu works across brand identity, product interface design, AI-assisted building, prototyping, and shipping. The portfolio is primarily in Chinese, with English project and role labels where useful.

## Public Profile

- GitHub: https://github.com/mongocyber
